findings.claim: The E_p x E_q Tate-curve assembly seed (asset 3, M2b) fails the Z5 gate at brief time, unconditionally and at a level worse than the gate's own worry: the (p,q)-graded family of surfaces carries NO correspondence content at all — no graphs, no diagonal, no prime-facing data, not even the feared bilinear-in-primes data.
findings.argument: Raw material confirmed against the program's own extraction of arXiv:2606.06604 (sources-extracted fulltext, sec. 4.1.2): E_p = C^x/p^Z ~ C/Lambda_p with Lambda_p = Z + Z*tau_p, tau_p = i*log(p)/(2*pi) — a rectangular torus, y_p := log(p)/(2*pi). (1) Isogeny criterion: a nonzero holomorphic map E_p -> E_q needs lambda=a+ib in C* with lambda*Lambda_p inside Lambda_q; lambda*1 forces a in Z, b in y_q*Z; lambda*(i*y_p) forces b*y_p in Z and a*y_p in y_q*Z. If a != 0 then y_p/y_q = log p/log q in Q, i.e. p^m = q^n — impossible by unique factorization. If a = 0, b = m*y_q != 0, then y_p*y_q in Q, i.e. (log p)(log q) in 4*pi^2*Q — an unproven transcendence coincidence. (2) Family-level unconditional kill: if for a fixed p two primes q != q' both satisfied y_p*y_q, y_p*y_q' in Q, then y_q/y_q' = log q/log q' in Q — impossible. So EVERY prime p has at most ONE exceptional partner q; for all other pairs Hom(E_p,E_q) = 0 unconditionally. The same two-pair argument kills cross-family maps E_q -> E_pq (y_q*y_pq, y_q*y_p'q in Q would force log(pq)/log(p'q) in Q). A correspondence family {Psi_n} with one primitive per prime and composition across the family needs nontrivial maps on essentially all pairs; at most one pair per prime can even conceivably carry one. (3) Consequences on the surfaces: NS(E_p x E_q) = Z*xi_1 + Z*xi_2 + Hom(E_p,E_q-hat), so for all non-exceptional pairs NS has rank 2 — fiber classes only; every curve in E_p x E_q is numerically a*xi_1 + b*xi_2 and acts as ZERO on H^1; there is no diagonal class in E_p x E_q for p != q (a diagonal exists only in E_p x E_p). Hence N2's central computation — 'which combinations Psi_f of graph classes make (Psi_f . Delta) reproduce the first prime terms of W(f) over E_2xE_3, E_2xE_5, E_3xE_5' — is ill-posed twice over: those surfaces contain no graph classes and no Delta. (4) On the diagonal surfaces E_p x E_p: End(E_p) = Z barring the analogous coincidence (log p)^2 in 4*pi^2*Q (tau_p imaginary quadratic = CM), so Corr = span(xi_1, xi_2, Delta), Lefschetz numbers of Gamma_m are the integers deg(m-1) = (m-1)^2 — polynomial in m, containing no log p. Intersection numbers on complex tori are topological integers; the explicit formula's prime terms Lambda(n)*f(log n)/sqrt(n) are transcendentally weighted reals. The ONLY way (Psi_f . Delta) = W(f) can hold is for the designer to insert the weights f(log(p^a*q^b)) by hand into the coefficients of Psi_f — a hand-weighted test family, i.e. barrier IV.1 re-entry ('no new data coordinate'), the exact C1 death the brief's Z2 promises to avoid ('C3's prime contact is the correspondence calculus itself or nothing' — it is nothing). (5) The escape the family does admit — the real-analytic isomorphisms lambda*e^{i*theta} -> lambda^{log q/log p}*e^{i*theta} conjugating the p-flow to the q-flow — is not holomorphic; using smooth or characteristic-one correspondences forfeits classical intersection positivity (Castelnuovo–Severi is a holomorphic/(1,1)-class fact), i.e. abandons the advertised selling point ('genus-1 fibers carrying CLASSICAL intersection theory... positivity free fiber-by-fiber') and lands back on the missing characteristic-one square. Net: the seed is not 'possibly bandwidth data in geometric dress' (R2's pricing) — it is EMPTY. The brief's own gate rule applies: 'if the gate cannot be passed on paper in a week of work, M2b is demoted to dormant with the failure recorded.' The gate is failed today, before design cost, per zoo section 0. Asset 3 of the thesis (the 'genuinely new substrate option the literature has never raised') is dead; its novelty question (R7a) is moot.

findings.claim: Lemma B (M0, the first deliverable and claimed S1 anchor) sits on an unavoidable definitional fork: every formalization of step 1 either smuggles the Euler product into the definition (Lemma B becomes a tautology restating zoo I.1's known witness, and the axiom class admits trivial zeta instantiations with zero zero-content) or uses trace data, under which step 2's 'formal monoid algebra' proof is false as stated. R8 prices this as a risk; it is a certainty. M0 survives only as an axiom-format note, not as a theorem.
findings.argument: The fork. Bidegrees of correspondences are multiplicative under composition (d_i(Psi'∘Psi) = d_i(Psi')*d_i(Psi): over a generic point, b(Z'∘Z) = b(Z)b(Z') fibers compose); intersection against the diagonal is NOT ((Psi_m∘Psi_n . Delta) is not a function of (Psi_m . Delta), (Psi_n . Delta)). HORN A (the Definition as literally written: 'degrees against the two fibers reproduce the counting data of D(s)'): then the Dirichlet data attached to any polarized Frobenius system has an Euler product BY DEFINITION — the degree data of {Psi_n} is forced multiplicative by the composition law before any geometry is consulted — so 'DH admits no polarized Frobenius system' reduces to 'Lambda_DH is not a nonnegative prime-power-supported system', which is the program's already-verified one-line witness (zoo I.1; I re-derived Lambda_DH(6) = +1.93636, Lambda_DH(12) = -0.76288 independently, below). Worse, Horn A's axiom class is trivially satisfiable for zeta with zero zero-location content: take X = P^1 x P^1 over the adelic curve of Q (the fibered square of C = P^1), Psi_n = graph of z -> z^n; then Psi_m∘Psi_n = Psi_mn exactly, Psi_p is primitive exactly at primes, O(1,1) is a nef polarization, the Psi_n are effective, and the bidegrees (1,n) 'reproduce the counting data of zeta' under any degree-based reading of the free 'reproduce' clause. So at the axiom level the filter is a filter on coefficient data only; the geometry is decoration, and 'zeta instantiates the axioms' can never by itself constitute progress (this converts Z6's vacuity adversary into a triviality adversary — the class is nonempty for zeta in a worthless way). HORN B (counting data = traces against Delta, the only non-circular reading — and the only one matching where counting data actually lives): then step 2's claim 'composition law + primitivity => prime-power support ... formal monoid algebra; no analysis' is FALSE as a formal claim, because trace data is not multiplicative under composition and no formal argument forces (Psi_6 . Delta)-type data to vanish; there is also no char-p precedent for the multiplicative-monoid trace structure (over F_q there is one prime; the tower is indexed by n in the EXPONENT, Psi_n = (Frob)^n, not by a multiplicative monoid with per-prime primitives). Moreover the brief's own template citation for the joint is misstated: 'the char-p model — degrees of graph-of-Frobenius powers on C x C reproducing point counts' is wrong — the bidegrees of Gamma_{F^n} are (1, q^n), which is only the MAIN term 1 + q^n of #C(F_{q^n}); the entire zero side (the sum of alpha_i^n) lives exclusively in the Delta-intersection (Lefschetz), which degrees never see. Exhaustiveness of the fork: any counting functional either factors through composition-multiplicative invariants (bidegrees; more generally the induced action on H^0/H^2) — Horn A — or involves H^1-trace data — Horn B; in every known template the zero side IS the H^1 trace, so no third option exists. Finally, step 3 as stated needs an effectivity axiom on the Psi_n that Definition (i)-(ii) omits; once added, 'Lambda_D(n) >= 0' is again quasi-definitional (nef against effective >= 0 is a basic property of the Yuan-Zhang calculus, not a theorem being consumed). Consequences: (a) 'provable today' is true only of the tautological horn; (b) the claim that Lemma B 'discharges the f1 scout's flag' is false — that flag asked for a proof that DH/Epstein have no F1-MODEL, which requires a formalized notion of F1-model and remains open; a definitional exclusion of non-Euler coefficient systems does not touch it; (c) asset 2 of the thesis ('an S1 anchor provable today') deflates to a re-dressing of zoo I.1. M0 must be repriced: publishable at most as a definition/axiom-format note with step 2 stated as an explicit hypothesis on Horn B.

Lemma B's entire coefficient-side axiom list — multiplicative monoid with per-prime primitives, prime-power support, Lambda >= 0 — is satisfied by every such system by construction; nothing in the Definition pins integer density, Ramanujan, or degree-one rigidity. Therefore even granting a full zeta instantiation, the axiom-level filter admits RH-false worlds: ALL RH content must come from the substrate-specific Hodge-index inequality (exactly as in char p, where the axioms without the geometry decide nothing), and the brief's S1 section header 'THE ANCHOR IS THE PART B LEMMA' plus thesis asset 2 overclaim what the anchor can ever certify. This is precisely zoo I.2's kill clause 'any route consuming only {Euler product, multiplicativity, pointwise positivity, integer-density regularity} — including Lambda(n) >= 0 as the S1 input ALONE' read against the anchor claim (not against the route architecture, which loads positivity on M3/M4 and is Deligne-shaped — that part is fine). Protocol breach: zoo I.7 ('CALIBRATION — binds Track-C/de-novo axiom sets: derive or cite as target the degree-one classification within the proposed axioms; exhibit the axiom that DMV worlds violate. Both clauses in writing before design cost') is nowhere in the brief; the brief's self-check Z1-Z6 runs only the DH world (I.1) and skips I.2/I.7 entirely, despite section 0's rule that a brief hitting a barrier without a written evasion is RETURNED. The repair is known and cheap: state honestly that the axiom set is an Euler-positivity filter separating {DH, Epstein} from {zeta} UNION {all Beurling worlds}, add the I.7 degree-one-rigidity target inside the axioms (per I.7 the closing bracket needs FE + Euler + Ramanujan at degree 1, Kaczorowski-Perelli), and relocate every S1 claim onto the substrate.

findings.claim: M3 (extend Yuan-Zhang Hodge index to proper adelic-curve bases) does not cross the base-vs-fiber mismatch; it relabels it. Within the Chen-Moriwaki formalism every base is still a base, and the doubled object the Weil template needs — the square of the arithmetic curve itself over an absolute point — is not expressible; making it expressible IS the substrate problem, not an extension of published technology. M3's instrument value is real; its role in the RH path is wholly contingent on M2.
findings.argument: A Chen-Moriwaki adelic curve is S = (K, (Omega,nu), (|.|_omega)) — an actual FIELD K with a measured family of absolute values satisfying the product formula (verified in the arithmetic-dynamics scout report and q-13a on disk); the standard example encoding Spec Z is K = Q with its places. In the Yuan-Zhang-over-adelic-curves calculus, 'a fibered square X with a nef adelic line bundle' is a VARIETY over K carrying adelic structure from the base — so the L-series-bearing object (S, i.e. Q/Spec Z) remains the BASE, exactly the configuration of Faltings-Hriljac/Moriwaki/Yuan-Zhang that the wave-1 arakelov scout certified as 'the base-vs-fiber mismatch no one has crossed'. What Weil's template needs is S itself as the FIBER curve, squared over an absolute point: S x_{F1} S. Products of adelic curves over an absolute point do not exist in the CM category — there is no field under Q to base-change along, and Spec Z is not a variety over any field (mixed characteristic; this IS the F1 problem). So M3 faces its own fork: (i) stay within fields-with-product-formula bases — then it is a genuine, publishable Arakelov instrument (function fields, trivially-valued fields, finitely generated fields), but by the brief's own scout the axioms at that level consume only product formula + metric positivity and are DH-dressable (S1 = 1, zoo III.21): nothing about the RH path is advanced, and 'the engine is waiting at the loading dock whichever substrate materializes' is unearned — the dock is on the wrong side of the mismatch; or (ii) extend the formalism to non-field bases (monoids, blueprints, Gamma-rings) so that Q can be the fiber — which is not 'a well-posed extension of published technology' (the brief's grading) but the de-novo substrate construction itself, i.e. M2 wearing M3's clothes. The brief's Z3 bullet even invites this check ('a killer should check M3's statement for a hidden relabeling'); the answer is: it is a relabeling, and the M3 milestone text plus thesis asset 1 should be rewritten to claim instrument value only, with the crossing explicitly assigned to M2.

findings.claim: Lemma B (the first deliverable, S1 anchor, and formalization-queue item 6) is not a theorem under either possible reading of its definition: under the literal 'degrees' reading it is FALSE (explicit counterexample constructed), and under the repaired 'trace' reading it is a definition, not a theorem — exactly the R8 degradation, now proven rather than priced.
findings.argument: The definition (brief §First Deliverable, clause ii) requires correspondences {Ψ_n} with Ψ_m∘Ψ_n=Ψ_mn, Ψ_p primitive exactly at primes, 'whose degrees against the two fibers reproduce the degree/counting data of an L-series D(s)'. HORN 1 (literal/degree reading — the reading the brief's own step-1 template mandates: 'the char-p model — degrees of graph-of-Frobenius powers on C×C reproducing point counts — is the template'). Counterexample: on X = P¹×P¹ over the proper adelic curve S = (Q, places) with the standard nef adelic bundle O(1,1), take Ψ_n = Γ_n = graph of z↦z^n. Then Γ_m∘Γ_n = Γ_mn exactly for all m,n (commutative), Ψ_1 = Δ, Ψ_p is primitive exactly at primes (p = ab impossible), every Ψ_n is an effective irreducible curve, and the degrees against the two fibers are (1, n) — precisely parallel to the char-p degrees d(Γ_{F^k}) = (1, q^k). Every stated axiom holds verbatim, and NOTHING in the axioms references the coefficients of D: the only stated D-contact is via degree data, so the identical system serves as a 'polarized Frobenius system' for D = ζ, D = DH, or D = Epstein indifferently. Hence 'DH admits no polarized Frobenius system' is false as stated. Independently, the degree reading is internally contradictory even for zeta: bidegrees multiply under composition of correspondences on curve-squares, so the composition law forces the degree data to be COMPLETELY multiplicative (c_mn = c_m·c_n for all m,n); but prime-power support requires c_pq = 0 for distinct p,q while complete multiplicativity gives c_pq = c_p·c_q ≠ 0 whenever two primes carry nonzero data — jointly satisfiable ONLY when at most one prime carries data, i.e. exactly the one-generator char-p monoid. The brief's template is a one-prime template misread as a multi-prime one. Moreover the template sentence itself is factually wrong: in char p the degrees of Γ_{F^k} are (1, q^k) and do NOT reproduce point counts; the counts are N_k = (Γ_{F^k}·Δ) = q^k + 1 − Σα_i^k (Lefschetz) — the difference between degree data and counting data IS the zero side, so a degree-based definition is structurally blind to zeros. HORN 2 (trace reading: counting data = (Ψ_n·Δ)-type numbers). Then proof-obligation step 2 ('Composition law + primitivity ⟹ prime-power support … formal monoid algebra; no analysis') is false: intersection numbers against Δ do not factor through composition — (Ψ∘Φ·Δ) is not a function of (Ψ·Δ),(Φ·Δ) — absent a Lefschetz trace-formula axiom tying composition to traces. In char p that tie is a THEOREM about the existing cohomology; over Q it is exactly the missing substrate (M2). Adding it as an axiom ('the counting data of D are trace-organized by the monoid') makes the D-attachment Euler-organized BY DEFINITION, so DH's exclusion follows from the definition plus the one-line coefficient witnesses — the geometry contributes nothing checkable. I verified in my own model: (Γ_n·Δ) = n+1 on P¹×P¹ (fixed points of z^n = z: (n−1)+2, Lefschetz-consistent), i.e. the trace reading pins the system to the zero-free D = ζ_{P¹}; realizing any D with zeros requires H¹-substance = the missing square, so the trace-reading 'lemma' has no provable-today content beyond the coefficient witnesses. CONSEQUENCE: M0's grade collapses from 'theorem, provable today, referee-evaluable' to 'axiom statement + numeric witnesses already on disk' — the fallback the brief itself admits is near-zero marginal content (zoo I.1 already records the axiom with the same witnesses, and names Blomer–Leung as the sharper formal home). Commission asset 2 ('An S1 anchor provable today') is refuted; the Z1 self-check answer ('that is M0's theorem') is refuted; the wave-2 scout's [V]-tagged 'Part B is provable today' is refuted — a demonstration that [V:scout] tags certify provenance, not truth, for provability assessments. Witness side independently re-verified per standing order 5: κ = 0.28407904384041229602829183239312616909109 (41 digits, from the surd (√(10−2√5)−2)/(√5−1)), Λ_DH(6) = +1.936356, Λ_DH(12) = −0.762877 (matching the program's +1.9364/−0.7629; note Λ_DH(4) = −1.442 < 0 is an even cheaper prime-power negativity witness), off-line zero residual |f_DH(ρ)| = 5.3e−16 at 15-digit input via independent Hurwitz-zeta evaluation, with |f_DH(1/2+85.699…i)| = 0.357 confirming off-line.

findings.claim: The Tate-curve E_p×E_q seed (M2b, commission asset 3, the 'genuinely new substrate option') is void: the cross-prime correspondence groups vanish, the diagonal does not exist, the fiberwise Hodge-index inequality is vacuous, and the assembled intersection data provably cannot host the explicit formula's linear prime terms. The Z5 gate — which the brief deferred to post-commissioning — FAILS on paper in one page.
findings.argument: From the tier-1 on-disk extraction of arXiv:2606.06604 (sources-extracted/…fulltext.txt, lines 1518–1596): E_p = C^×/p^Z ≅ C/Λ_p with Λ_p = Z ⊕ Zτ_p, τ_p = i·log p/(2π) (q = 1/p). (1) Hom(E_p, E_q) = 0 for p ≠ q barring a transcendence miracle: a nonzero α with αΛ_p ⊆ Λ_q gives α·1 = a + bτ_q, α·τ_p = c + dτ_q (a,b,c,d ∈ Z); the imaginary part forces a·log p = d·log q, so a = d = 0 (log p/log q rational would give p^u = q^v); the real part then forces b·log p·log q = −4π²c, i.e. an isogeny exists IFF log p·log q ∈ π²·Q — no such relation is known for any pair and none is expected (four-exponentials-type territory). (2) UNCONDITIONAL coherence kill for the brief's own N2 sandbox {E_2×E_3, E_2×E_5, E_3×E_5}: if all three pairs admitted nonzero correspondences, then log2·log3 = π²r₁, log2·log5 = π²r₂, log3·log5 = π²r₃ with r_i ∈ Q, whence log3/log2 = √(r₁r₃/r₂)/√(r₁r₂/r₃) = |r₃/r₂| ∈ Q — contradiction with unique factorization (3^v = 2^u). So at least one cross group is provably zero, and any composition-coherent family over all pairs of primes is unconditionally impossible; generically all cross groups vanish. Since divisorial correspondences E_p ⊢ E_q modulo fiber classes ≅ Hom(E_p,E_q), the off-diagonal surfaces carry ONLY the two fiber classes: NS(E_p×E_q) has rank 2. Consequences, each individually disqualifying: (a) no diagonal Δ exists on E_p×E_q for p ≠ q (E_p ≇ E_q barring the same π²-miracle class), so the target pairing (Ψ_f·Δ) = W(f) has no Δ to pair against; (b) the Castelnuovo–Severi/Hodge-index inequality is VACUOUS on every off-diagonal member: the orthogonal complement of the two fiber classes in a rank-2 hyperbolic NS is zero — the brief's 'the positivity is free fiber-by-fiber' is true only because there is nothing to be positive about; (c) the family is totally disconnected as a category (all comparison maps between distinct fibers are zero), so the 'descent/compatibility datum ACROSS the family' has no material to glue — the multiplicativity axiom becomes a formal index-bookkeeping label carried by no geometry, i.e. the S1 axiom is formally inserted, not geometrically consumed (the exact Z6 vacuity failure); (d) the total intersection-data class available to any assembly is {constants} ∪ {bilinear cross-terms a_pq·b'_pq + a'_pq·b_pq in per-prime fiber labels} ∪ {per-prime End = Z multiplication-graph data on the diagonal surfaces E_p×E_p (End(E_p) = Z since CM would need log²p ∈ π²Q), whose intersection numbers (Γ_[n]·Δ) = deg([n]−1) are universal polynomials carrying no arithmetic}. The Weil explicit formula's prime side is LINEAR in Λ(p)f(log p); linear prime terms, the archimedean term, and the pole term can enter this data class only by hand-insertion of the answer key into the weights. This is the complete, proven form of the Z5 failure the brief feared ('bandwidth-style data in geometric dress' — in fact worse: the geometric layer contributes nothing at all). N2 as drafted is ill-posed ('enumerate correspondence classes… which combinations of graph classes make (Ψ_f·Δ) reproduce prime terms' — there are no graph classes and no Δ on the off-diagonal surfaces). Process note: the zoo's binding rule (V.1, §0) requires gates executable at brief time to run BEFORE commissioning; Z5 was executable in one page (this page) and was instead deferred to 'M2b feasibility-note stage'. The seed's novelty claim ([RU], R7a) is simultaneously resolved: no prior art found online (consistent with the brief), and the explanation is that the construction dies immediately. Asset 3 of the commission is destroyed; the 'first empirical data ever on the seed' (N2) would have measured an empty calculus.

findings.claim: M3 (Part A, the Yuan–Zhang extension to proper adelic-curve bases) does not cross the base-vs-fiber mismatch — it relabels it, answering the brief's own Z3 challenge in the negative. Its value is instrument-grade only, and the brief's on-disk corpus claim for it cites the wrong Chen–Moriwaki volume.
findings.argument: A Chen–Moriwaki adelic curve S = (K,(Ω,ν),(|·|_ω)) is a field with a measured family of absolute values — an abstraction of the BASE role of Spec Z/Spec O_K. M3 extends the theorem class {X over number-field bases} to {X over arbitrary proper adelic-curve bases}: it liberalizes which bases are allowed, but in every instantiation X remains a K-scheme whose fibers are geometric varieties over the field K, with the arithmetic (product formula) living in the base structure ν. For the RH application the avatar C of Spec Z must be the FIBER curve squared; that requires an adelic curve S₀ strictly under it with C of relative dimension 1 over K₀ — but Q is algebraic over its prime field, so Q is the function field of a curve over NO subfield: exhibiting such an S₀ with fiber data encoding ζ IS the missing substrate (M2), not a corollary of base-generalization. So M3's statement satisfies the brief's crossing criterion ('adelic-curve bases where the fiber data encode D(s)') only in instantiations where D is Beurling/function-field-dressable — precisely the substrate-blindness barrier III.21 already certifies (the wave-2 scout's own S1 = 1 scoring: the machinery consumes only product formula + metric positivity). M3 is honest as instrument ('publishable machinery even if every substrate fails') but unearned as a milestone 'toward M4'. Prior-art status probed online per R7(b): Yuan–Zhang I–II (arXiv:1304.3538/9; Part II already extends number fields → finitely generated fields) and Chen–Moriwaki's separate 'Arithmetic intersection theory over adelic curves' (arXiv:2103.15646, Mém. SMF 2022) exist; no published Hodge index over adelic curves surfaced in my searches, so M3-as-open is not pre-empted as far as probed (the IMJ-PRG server refused connections — flagged), but the extension is 'in the air' for the CM school given their intersection theory + positivity layers. Corpus error: the brief's 'full intersection theory: corpus q-13a on disk' is wrong — q-13a is the 2019 LNM volume 'Arakelov geometry over adelic curves' (arXiv:1903.10798; norms, slopes, heights — I verified the on-disk file's title page and table of contents), while the intersection theory is the 2021 Mémoire, NOT on disk; the 'On disk now (sufficient for…)' inventory is therefore wrong for Part-A-adjacent work (free on arXiv, so no sponsor load, but the sufficiency claim is false as written).

findings.claim: The brief never runs barrier I.2 (Beurling factory) or I.7 (degree-one rigidity) on the polarized-Frobenius axiom class — a protocol HIT under the zoo's binding rule — and the axiom class as drafted fails both: it contains no functional-equation/duality axiom, and every Λ-level consequence Lemma B can extract is satisfied by RH-false Beurling/DMV worlds, so even a repaired Lemma B anchors far less than the commission claims.
findings.argument: Zoo §0 step 2 requires the model-world battery for EVERY consumed axiom, including Beurling/Axiom-A worlds; I.7's executable test demands, in writing before design cost, (a) the axiom DMV worlds violate and (b) degree-one rigidity as a derivable target within the proposed axioms. The brief's self-check section runs Z1 (DH), Z2, Z3, Z4, Z5, Z6 — I.2 and I.7 are absent, and no axiom violated by DMV worlds is named anywhere. Substantively: the exclusion boundary Lemma B can enforce (under any reading, per fatal 1) is 'Λ_D supported on prime powers and Λ_D(n) ≥ 0'. Beurling generalized number systems satisfy full Euler products with Λ_P(n) ≥ 0 pointwise automatically (I.2) while violating RH maximally (DMV: zeros filling the de la Vallée Poussin boundary; Broucke's factories planting zeros on prescribed contours, discretizable preserving Λ_P ≥ 0). So the 'axiom-level Euler-product filter' excludes DH/Epstein but NOT the published RH-false factory — the S1 anchor cannot be 'the' axiom-level anchor for a full-RH construction; per I.7 the closing bracket additionally needs FE + Ramanujan-type axioms, and the polarized-Frobenius definition contains no functional-equation/duality axiom at all (the Mechanism section's 'closed under transpose' is never tied to Ψ_n by an axiom — in the char-p template the FE is Rosati/Poincaré duality relating Γ_F^t to q/F, an axiom the definition omits). Note the exclusion profile is also OVER-broad in a revealing way: with counting-data nonnegativity as the filter, RH-true Euler-intact objects with signed coefficients (χ₄, any GL(2) L-function with a_p < 0, i.e. Λ_D(p) < 0) are excluded alongside DH — the filter is a positivity filter, not an Euler-product filter, and its semantics do not match the commission's S1 narrative. Fixable by axiom additions (duality axiom; I.7 clauses in writing), but as commissioned the brief hits the zoo rule: 'a brief that hits any barrier without an explicit, written evasion argument is RETURNED before design cost.'

findings.claim: The S6-compliance claim ('finite-rank/tower rationality is the correspondence trace calculus … COMPLIANT BY DESIGN') is contradicted by the design's own pairing target and never engages III.20's rationality clause.
findings.argument: III.20 records that Deligne's squeeze needs RATIONALITY (finitely many eigenvalues of fixed weight, integer counts) — 'the exact coordinate with no archimedean analog, where the transfer dies.' C3's target pairing (Ψ_f·Δ) = W(f) is real-valued with transcendental prime terms Λ(n)/√n, built from continuous families Ψ_f = ∫f(λ)Ψ_λ d*λ, over a correspondence group containing Ψ_p for every prime — an infinite-rank, non-rational trace calculus by construction. The brief's S6 paragraph asserts 'finite-rank divisor/correspondence groups' with 'the char-p model being literal counting', but no candidate substrate (A/B/C) has finite-rank Corr, and no analog of the tower-overdetermination (integer point counts over F_{q^n} pinning finitely many eigenvalues) is identified or even discussed for the archimedean side. The S6 box is checked by assertion; the rationality half of the spec is unaddressed. Minor because S6 is declared a bet ('the program's S6 existence bet'), but the compliance language overstates.

findings.claim: Verified in the brief's favor (killer's confirmation duties): M1's [RU] non-circularity fact is TRUE and cheap; N1 is feasible in minutes with both witnesses; the Morishita bridge exists; the DH numerical infrastructure replicates exactly.
findings.argument: (1) M1: I re-derived the Hodge-index-on-surfaces skeleton myself (H ample, D·H = 0, D numerically nontrivial ⟹ D² < 0: if D² > 0, Riemann–Roch χ(nD) = (n²/2)D² − (n/2)D·K + χ(O) → ∞ forces ±nD effective for large n, and effective nonzero meets ample H positively — contradiction; no zeta input anywhere), and verified at tier-1 that the lineage exists as recalled: Mattuck–Tate, Abh. Math. Sem. Hamburg 22 (1958) (Castelnuovo–Severi from RR on the surface) and Grothendieck, 'Sur une note de Mattuck-Tate', J. reine angew. Math. 200 (1958) 208–215 (index theorem on any surface, simplifying to Hodge index; confirmed via Crelle/EuDML records). The [RU] tag on the function-field non-circularity fact is discharged: M1 is real, standard, and one afternoon of writing. (2) N1: computed myself for Q = x² + 5y² (D = −20, h = 2): r_Q = (2,0,0,2,2,4,0,0,6,…); Λ_Q(6) = +3.5835 (support off prime powers) and Λ_Q(36) = −7.1670 < 0 — both witness types exist by n ≤ 36; the 'hours' estimate is if anything conservative (minutes). (3) Morishita arXiv:2508.15971 exists ('On a relation between Deninger's foliated dynamical systems and Connes-Consani's adelic spaces', 26pp, class-field-theoretic framing consistent with the brief's R5 caution; I could confirm v4 html — the brief's 'v5 Jan 2026' version claim not confirmed, flagged). These confirmations do not rescue the commission: they salvage M1, N1, and M2c as the honest residue after the fatals.

findings.claim: Barrier-zoo protocol violation: the brief never runs I.2 (Beurling counterexample factory) or I.7 (degree-one rigidity calibration) against its own polarized-Frobenius axiom class, although I.7 explicitly BINDS Track-C/de-novo axiom sets and demands both clauses in writing before design cost — and C1 was adjudicated dead partly on exactly this hole.
findings.argument: The brief's barrier section runs Z1 (DH at axiom level), Z2 (Weil-disguise), Z3 (named no-gos), Z4 (conductor law), Z5 (bilinearity), Z6 (vacuity) — but not the Beurling battery. BARRIER-ZOO.md I.2 kills 'any route consuming only {Euler product, multiplicativity, pointwise positivity, integer-density regularity}', and I.7's executable test reads: 'For any Track-C/de-novo brief: derive (or cite as target) the degree-one classification within the proposed axioms; exhibit the axiom that DMV worlds violate. Both clauses in writing before design cost.' The polarized-Frobenius axioms as printed (composition law Ψ_m∘Ψ_n=Ψ_mn, per-prime primitivity, degrees reproducing counting data, nef polarization) force exactly Euler product + Λ_D(n)≥0 — the axiom package Beurling systems satisfy automatically (Λ_P≥0 pointwise, free monoid on generalized primes). Worse, the program's own wave-2 arithmetic-dynamics scout states in its S1 row that 'a DH/Beurling-like structure can be dressed as a proper adelic curve; S1 lives entirely in the substrate' — i.e. the Chen–Moriwaki base the brief builds Lemma B on is certified Beurling-compatible by the brief's own source. So the burden is live, not hypothetical: either a DMV/discretized-planted-zero world can instantiate the polarized-Frobenius axioms (then the axiom class cannot decide RH and all RH content must be shown to sit in M4's theta-effectivity input, with the DMV-violated input named), or it cannot, and the brief must say which axiom fails and why. Precedent: adjudication-C1 mandatory repair 5 killed C1's M4 because 'the OS+CM axiom system as drafted holds in DMV worlds' (BARRIER-ZOO I.2 KILLS list). This does not refute C3 — the brief's Z6 already concedes the exclusion lemma alone is not RH progress, and the honest resolution is almost certainly 'the axioms alone are Beurling-instantiable; the deciding input is h⁰_θ effectivity at M4' — but under the zoo's binding rule an unwritten evasion is no evasion. Repair: add a written I.2/I.7 clause to the brief (and to the Lemma-B write-up before it becomes the program-wide S1 citation), stating the Beurling instantiation status of the axioms and the degree-one rigidity target within them.

findings.claim: The E_p × E_q seed's novelty claim survives only in a narrow form: the online prior-art gate (run here per R7(a), which the brief itself queued) finds three adjacent published traditions the brief's search list misses entirely, one of which (Kurokawa/Akatsuka absolute tensor square) materially sharpens gate Z5.
findings.argument: Searches (Aug 2026): (1) Connes–Consani–Marcolli, 'The Weil Proof and the Geometry of the Adeles Class Space' (Manin Festschrift, Birkhäuser 2008; arXiv:math/0703392) already builds a dictionary between the steps of the Weil proof and the adele class space 'with good working notions of correspondences, degree, and codegree' — including Frobenius-type scaling correspondences with the composition law realized by the scaling flow. This is the closest existing axiomatization to the brief's 'polarized Frobenius system' and it is nowhere engaged; a hostile referee of Lemma B will demand the comparison (in particular why CCM's degree/codegree calculus with its known failure of the trivial-correspondence degree-adjustment at the archimedean place does not already contain, or block, the definition). Banaszak–Uetake's operator-theoretic abstract intersection theory (arXiv:0908.2909; on disk as t-30b/t-43b/t-58a and routed to Track-C in corpus-routing.md) is a second unengaged axiomatization of the same target. (2) The Kurokawa absolute tensor product tradition (Kurokawa 1992; Manin, Lectures on zeta functions and motives, Astérisque 228, which explicitly treats 'Z ⊗_F1 Z' via Kurokawa tensor products; Koyama–Kurokawa; Akatsuka, 'The double Riemann zeta function', Comm. Number Theory Phys. 3 (2009) 619–653; arXiv:2008.07752 for Dirichlet L) is the established mathematics of 'the zeta of the square of Spec Z': its Euler product runs over PAIRS of primes and its zeros are SUMS ρ₁+ρ₂ of zeta zeros. This is precisely the bilinear-in-pairs-of-primes data class gate Z5 fears, now with a published calibration: the Z5 gate should add the explicit check that the (p,q)-assembly's colimit reproduces W(f) (single-prime support, zeros ON the line) and not the Kurokawa tensor-square data (pair support, zeros = sums) — the natural failure mode of a pairwise-product family now has a name and a literature. (3) Scholze's ICM-2018 report (Rio.pdf) already pictures Spec A_inf as 'Spec O_C♭ × Spec Z_p' — per-prime self-products as realized pieces of the arithmetic square — and the Feb-2026 arXiv:2602.04978 (global z-adic Hodge theory curves) shows this frontier is moving; the June-2026 CC paper itself ties E_p to the Fargues–Fontaine curve. VERDICT on novelty: no source found proposing classical complex Tate-curve products E_p × E_q with abelian-surface intersection theory and cross-family multiplicativity descent — the seed's specific form appears genuinely new — but the brief's R7(a) list (CC orbit, Haran, vdG–Schoof, Manin F1, Smirnov) must be extended by these three traditions before any novelty claim is published, and Z5 must absorb the Kurokawa calibration.

findings.claim: Lemma B's printed definition omits the effectivity axiom its own step 3 consumes, and the total-multiplicativity axiom silently restricts the admissible Euler shape to degree one — both fixable in the write-up, but a referee will catch both.
findings.argument: The definition (§First deliverable, (i)–(ii)) posits 'a family of correspondences {Ψ_n}' with the composition law and degree-matching; nowhere is Ψ_n required EFFECTIVE. Step 3's mechanism ('nonnegativity because the relevant degrees are intersection numbers of effective correspondences against a nef polarization') is false for general correspondence classes, which are differences of effective ones and can have negative degrees — effectivity must be an axiom or Λ_D(n) ≥ 0 does not follow. Second, Ψ_m∘Ψ_n = Ψ_mn for ALL m,n (not just coprime) makes the fiber-degree data totally multiplicative, hence forces Euler factors of shape (1−a_p p^{−s})^{−1}: right for ζ (a_p=1, Λ(p^k)=log p — and the step-2 claim 'prime-power support + Λ_D(p^k)=f(Λ_D(p),k) by formal monoid algebra' is then genuinely correct and cheap, which I verified by writing out the monoid computation), but it excludes every higher-degree Euler-intact L-function, and it differs from the function-field template the brief invokes, where the Frobenius monoid is generated by ONE prime (F^m, m≥1). The write-up must state this scope restriction explicitly or the axioms misdescribe their own template. Neither point degrades the DH/Epstein kill (with effectivity added, Λ_DH(12)=−0.76<0 and Λ_DH(6)≠0 close the contradiction in one line each); R8's honest fallback (lemma degrades to a definition of admissible D if step 1 cannot avoid circularity) already prices the worst case correctly.

findings.claim: The kill-criterion is only semi-executable: M2b is time-boxed by gate Z5 ('a week'), but M2a and M2c carry no termination condition, so the trigger 'M2 fails on all three sub-routes' may never formally fire — against the brief's own conceded 8-year stall base rate (R1), this is a designed-in zombie mode.
findings.argument: M2a's failure mode is 'no movement' on the CC square — undated; the brief itself documents that CC have not moved in 8 years and did not even name the square as future work in June 2026, so 'no movement' is the modal state indefinitely. M2c's stated dichotomy (transplant ALKL to the Witt space OR prove the transplant impossible) treats a no-go proof as the cheap exit, but proving impossibility of a transplant to a non-manifold space is itself a research problem; the realistic modal outcome is neither branch — partial progress and stall — which the kill-criterion does not recognize. Note the model-world precedent for the timescale: the Guillemin–Deninger trace formula that ALKL proved took roughly two decades to reach theoremhood on CLOSED MANIFOLDS; expecting transplant-or-refutation on a non-manifold Witt space inside a program horizon without a session budget is unpriced. Repair: time-box M2a (natural anchor: the [CC7] re-check ≥ Nov 2026 plus one design session — if [CC7] posts nothing square-shaped and the M2a checkpoint theorem has not advanced, M2a goes dormant), and give M2c a fixed session budget with an obstruction ledger whose exhaustion counts as 'failed' for the kill-criterion (the no-go write-up can then be attempted from the ledger). Without these, C3 cannot honestly convert to the documented no-go its own lifecycle promises.

findings.claim: The thesis-level claim 'success at every intermediate rung is independently publishable' is inflated for the two rungs a strong group will actually land (M0, M1); it is accurate for the two rungs unlikely to land inside the horizon (M2c, M3). Priced standalone under the modal outcome (M4 never happens), C3's expected value is a modest instrument shelf plus a documented no-go — real, but the brief's value sentence overstates the front of the ladder.
findings.argument: Rung by rung. M0 (Lemma B + witnesses): correct and cheap — I executed both witness computations (see the verification finding) and the write-up is genuinely session-scale — but as a standalone publication it is an exclusion lemma for an axiom class only this program has adopted; its natural life is an arXiv note + the program-internal S1 citation (which is exactly the value the milestone text itself claims — the inflation is only in the thesis sentence). M1: re-derivation of Castelnuovo–Severi from RR + ampleness (Mattuck–Tate/Grothendieck; Hartshorne Ex. V.1.9–1.10) is textbook graduate material — zero publishability, high internal value (it discharges the [RU] on the load-bearing non-circularity fact; the A2 precedent shows why this must actually be done). M2c: either branch, if landed, is genuinely publishable — a derivation of the explicit formula from a space would be a major paper — but probability-of-landing is low (see the kill-criterion finding). M3 (Hodge index over proper adelic-curve bases): confirmed OPEN by online search (no adelic-curve-base Hodge index exists; nearest results are Abboud's local Hodge index over quasiprojective varieties, arXiv:2503.14099, and the YZ originals), and genuinely instrument-grade for the Chen–Moriwaki school itself if landed; moreover the brief's R3 hardness pricing is slightly pessimistic because the school's positivity layer over adelic curves partially EXISTS: Chen–Moriwaki, 'Positivity in Arakelov Geometry over Adelic Curves: Hilbert–Samuel Formula and Equidistribution Theorem', Progress in Mathematics 355 (Birkhäuser 2024) — a volume absent from the brief's fetch list (which carries only the LNM intersection-theory book q-13a). Net referee estimate for 'M0+M1 in one session-scale effort by a strong group': credible but tight — N1 costs hours (verified: minutes), the Lemma-B write-up with an honest step-1 formalization is the bulk, M1 plus the E_p×E_q index baseline pushes the pair toward 1.5–2 sessions. Mildly optimistic, not fantasy.

findings.claim: VERIFICATION FINDING (positive): both Lemma-B witnesses re-derived independently and N1 executed in advance — the Epstein witness exists within the specified range and is even cheaper than priced; six [V:] tags spot-checked against the sweep JSONs and decisive-test files with zero paraphrase drift.
findings.argument: (a) DH: from a_n = (1, κ, −κ, −1, 0) mod 5 with κ re-derived from the classical surd (√(10−2√5)−2)/(√5−1) — matching the program's 41-digit value to 1.7e−16 — the von Mangoldt recursion gives Λ_DH(6) = +1.936356 and Λ_DH(12) = −0.762877, exactly the brief's witnesses. Bonus for the write-up: Λ_DH(3) = −κ·log 3 = −0.312 < 0 and Λ_DH(4) = −1.442 < 0, so negativity has witnesses at n=3 (a prime) and n=4 (a prime power) — cheaper than n=12.
